LESSON: GUIDED READING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.3 Reading Aloud (2 lessons) • Vocabulary Expansion • Fluency (speed an
Topic 2.5: Guided Reading

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Guided Reading
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What clues can help you comprehend a text?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. recite key words, expressions and phrasesin simple texts
2. show awareness of the importance of correct articulation when reading texts

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Guided Reading

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Guided Reading

Teach
• Focus skill: recite key words, expressions and phrasesin simple texts.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Guided Reading.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Guided Reading
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What clues can help you comprehend a text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
